extracted.intended_audience: Plans Directorate staff and component reporting managers (CIA); agency personnel implementing OMB Circular A-44 paperwork reduction
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for conducting a consolidated inventory of periodic and recurring Directorate reporting under OMB Circular A-44, costing those reports, identifying low-utility items, and projecting paperwork/man-hour savings from changes in reporting procedures. Intended to inform review, modification, frequency changes, and discontinuance decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consolidated inventory requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: This memorandum with Form 142 attachments represents a consolidated inventory of Plans Directorate periodic and recurring reporting as required under OMB Circular A-44.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare and submit a consolidated inventory (using Form 142 attachments) listing periodic and recurring reports required under Circular A-44 for the Directorate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Treatment of imprecise report titles and missing entries
rubrics_metrics.description: The speed with which the inventory was conducted, the imprecision of reports titles, and the participation of the fifteen components and subordinate units ... have caused the employment of considerable arbitrariness in sorting out inconsistencies and assigning cost factors. Interpolations based on submitted data were made in instances where a component should have but did not include a specific report in its listing. In other cases, reports of similar format serving identical purposes but labeled differently have been combined as a single entry.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When report titles are imprecise or entries are missing, use reasonable interpolation, combine similarly purposed reports even if labeled differently, and document any arbitrary or judgmental choices made during reconciliation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Costing methodology and inclusion/exclusion of cost elements
rubrics_metrics.description: By and large computations are based on a weighted average grade cost and include only the costs of preparing and issuing the report. Costs of report formulations and echelon use of same were excluded under the Directorate formula.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compute report costs using a weighted average grade cost metric. Include only direct costs of preparing and issuing reports; explicitly exclude upstream costs such as report formulation and costs associated with higher-echelon use to avoid double-counting—this will likely produce conservative cost estimates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope: which reports are included or excepted
rubrics_metrics.description: In addition to reporting exclusions contained in the several directives, the DDP issued supplementary guidelines excepting all reports required by other CIA directorates and ad hoc items. Included in this submission are administrative management and operational reporting required external of the Agency, reporting required by the Executive Offices and Officers of CIA, reporting levied by DDP components upon other directorates, and administrative, management and operational reporting required within Plans itself.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow DDP supplementary guidelines to except reports mandated by other directorates and ad hoc items. For the Directorate submission, include administrative, management and operational reports required external to the Agency, required by Executive Offices/Officers, levied on other directorates by DDP components, and reports required within Plans.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comprehensiveness metric (item count and consolidated costing)
rubrics_metrics.description: A consolidated costing of the 144 reported items contained herein totals [summary presented].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide an explicit count of reported items and a consolidated cost total for transparency and to support savings projections (document the count and how combined/merged entries affect totals).

rubrics_metrics.name: Anticipated savings estimation with stated uncertainty
rubrics_metrics.description: Major changes in Project Actions, Project Reviews and the Operating Program intended to implement country based programming and to integrate the present fragmented system impact heavily on projected reporting goals ... Substantial savings of perhaps [redacted] are estimated to accrue from newly announced DDP changes ... There is no experience upon which to base this theoretical goal, therefore, while it is cited in absolute monetary terms it is indeed tentative.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When projecting savings from reporting changes, quantify anticipated savings but explicitly state the uncertainty and tentative nature if there is no prior experience; separate savings due to internal management changes from those attributable to external initiatives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Criteria for modifying, reducing frequency, or discontinuing reports
rubrics_metrics.description: Chief, FE has taken a hard look at specialized reporting generated in response to requirements within his component with the result that he expects through changes in procedures, modification of reports, changes in reporting frequency and discontinuance of others that his Division will realize man-hour savings ...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify specialized reporting that can be changed via procedural revisions, report modification, frequency adjustments, or discontinuance. Estimate man-hour impacts for each proposed change and document procedural steps required to implement them.

rubrics_metrics.name: Net projected savings reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: For the A-44 exercise the combined Directorate net projected savings is about 10 percent of cited current costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Calculate and report a Directorate-level net projected savings percentage (e.g., ~10%) relative to current reported costs, and show the calculation basis and assumptions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Attribution of savings to causes (distinguish OMB action vs internal changes)
rubrics_metrics.description: None of the anticipated savings can be directly attributable to OMB's initiative. It is a happenstance that the Circular A-44 action coincided with major management changes and reporting reviews ...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When evaluating realized or projected savings, analyze and state whether savings stem from the external OMB initiative or from coincident internal management changes; avoid assuming causation by policy timing alone.

rubrics_metrics.name: Minimize field burden — require only necessary reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: The Directorate has periodically reviewed its generation of paper and the particular burden placed upon field installations in an effort to require only that which is necessary. Experience in this regard tells us there is scant slack in this area.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess and minimize the reporting burden on field installations; only require reports that are necessary and feasible, recognizing there may be little redundant or removable reporting at field level.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identification and review process for reports of doubtful utility
rubrics_metrics.description: Finally, components identified 14 reports (contained in the inventory) which the preparing unit finds of doubtful utility or questions the frequency level. These will be reviewed during the coming year to determine what if any modification can be effected. Five of these are in response to requirements of other Government Offices. For this reason changes in these areas are considered unlikely.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain a list of reports flagged as of doubtful utility or with questionable frequency; schedule a formal review process to consider modification or discontinuance, but note that reports required by other government offices may not be alterable and are unlikely to change.

rubrics_metrics.name: Implementation timeline for projected reporting goals
rubrics_metrics.description: Major changes ... impact heavily on projected reporting goals to be attained by October 1971.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When planning reporting changes, set and communicate target dates for attainment of goals (e.g., specific month/year) and tie projected savings and changes to an implementation timeline.
